viewing_check: Count completeness: 9 minifigs (Vladek, Shadow Knights, skeleton, etc.), portcullis, gate, catapult/launcher, banners, horse, number of the 967 pieces roughly (bag size). Check for missing walls, discolouring (red/black fading), stickers, and loose pieces from other sets mixed in. Check the instruction book is the full booklet. Photograph the minifigs and the underside of the base.
